Tomato Soup

Ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, chopped
3 garlic cloves
2 cans chopped tomatoes (400 g each)
500 ml vegetable stock
a pinch of sugar
salt and pepper to taste

Method:
Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook 1 more minute.

Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20-25 minutes.

Blend until smooth and season with salt and pepper.
